text:
maya: Promo stuck on deploybot — staging -> prod blocked due to artifact verify fail for frontend assets bundle. Anyone on deploybot?

deploy-bot: promotion failed: artifact verification error: symlink target mismatch for /artifacts/frontend/static (expected blob abc123, got missing). Holding promotion.

alice: saw NFS maintenance earlier on eu-west nodes, could be symlink resolution across mounts.

dave: logs show partial upload then retry; final symlink not updated. snippet: `verify: open /mnt/artifacts/frontend/static/index.html: no such file or directory`

carla: is this the same as yesterday's mirror sync issue? path looks different. Can we pin to last-good commit to unblock the release?

bob: we can manual-pin, but customers on canary will still see the new artifact until reupload completes. option: pin to last-good + kick reupload and smoke.

maya: what's the manual command?

alice: `./deploy promote --pin abcdef --reason "artifact symlink race"` (requires an approval from SRE or release owner).

dave: I can run a quick smoke on last-good. quick check: cache index has stale entry `/frontend/static -> blob xyz789` which was the last-good.

ci-bot: ci-bot: queued `artifact-publish-frontend` reupload job (run id 3821). Suggestion: set env `USE_ATOMIC_SYMLINK=true` to reduce window for symlink races.

carla: :thumbsup: I'll enable `USE_ATOMIC_SYMLINK` and start the reupload. maya, want me to kick the job?

maya: please kick and add a note to release notes saying we performed a manual pin + reupload. Also add rollback instructions.

alice: approval ready pending smoke. dave, ping when smoke done.

dave: smoke passed on last-good (basic smoke + end-to-end static fetch). approving manual pin now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: manual promotion approved by dave; promoting commit abcdef -> prod. Reupload job in progress (run 3821). Rollback plan: revert to commit xyz789 and re-route traffic to canary if any user-impact reported.

maya: thanks everyone. I'll update the change window notes and add a short postmortem blurb in the release notes: why we pinned, what fix went into reupload (atomic symlink), and follow-up to confirm NFS maintenance schedule.

bob: next action item: add a small e2e that checks final symlink resolution after artifact publish to catch this earlier. Filing a quick ticket.

ci-bot: ci-bot: ticket created #INC-4129 "verify artifact symlink post-publish e2e".

maya: closing thread once reupload is green and prod verification passes. Thanks all :heart:
